nodes.label: Commit updated tender data step
nodes.rationale: digest_state.json only added if it exists, since git add of a missing path was silently killing the step.

nodes.label: checkForAlerts()
nodes.rationale: New and closing-soon alerts deduped via localStorage so the same tender does not re-notify on every periodic check.

nodes.label: Template placeholders (NEW_COUNT, DUE_SOON_COUNT, RUN_TIME, NEW_SECTION, DUE_SOON_SECTION, DASHBOARD_URL)
nodes.norm_label: template placeholders (new_count, due_soon_count, run_time, new_section, due_soon_section, dashboard_url)

nodes.label: SendGrid email digest
nodes.rationale: Configuration lives only in GitHub Actions secrets/variables because the repo is public.

nodes.label: Digest throttling (MIN_HOURS_BETWEEN_DIGESTS / digest_state.json)
nodes.rationale: Closing-soon tenders re-included in every digest; without a minimum gap (default 6h) it would email every 15 minutes.

nodes.label: Merge-and-retain until due date behavior
nodes.rationale: Each run loads existing tenders.json, adds unseen tenders by stable id, drops only once due date passes, so matches persist after scrolling off the source's 10-latest window.

nodes.label: update-tenders concurrency group
nodes.rationale: Queue a run rather than overlap with one in progress.

nodes.label: Install Playwright browser step
nodes.rationale: Only needed while sources.json has a js_rendered_table source enabled; adds real time to every run.

nodes.label: 15-minute cron schedule
nodes.rationale: Matches how often each portal's free latest-10 homepage widget rotates, so a tender is caught before it scrolls off; email digests throttled separately.

nodes.label: Known ceiling: 10-latest homepage widget
nodes.rationale: Paginated Tenders-by-Closing-Date crawl triggered captcha bot-detection; project refuses to work around captchas, so frequent checks of the 10-latest widget are the practical ceiling.

nodes.label: No captcha circumvention principle
nodes.rationale: No OCR-solving or request-spacing tricks; a real person completes the captcha step.

nodes.label: openTenderInfoModal()
nodes.rationale: Title travels in URL fragment so the autofill bookmarklet can read it without sending it to the server.

nodes.label: Find on official site modal
nodes.rationale: GePNIC DirectLink is session-scoped (Stale Session), so no deep link; modal shows title/ref no to copy plus stable searchUrl.

nodes.label: TYPE_FETCHERS safety net
nodes.rationale: Only types with a registered fetcher are scraped regardless of enabled flag; blocked_by_robots_txt, paid_aggregator (ToS) and unsupported sources listed for visibility only.

nodes.label: TENDER_SHOW_ALL flag
nodes.rationale: Defaults true: live dashboard intentionally shows every scraped tender, non-matches tagged General / All Tenders.
